confidence_notes: July prices are approximate. Restaurant estimates draw on a [May price snapshot](https://www.averagecostof.living/in/mexico/queretaro-santiago-de-queretaro-mexico/restaurants) and [November crowdsourced data](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Queretaro-Santiago-de-Queretaro-Mexico). The [cocktail price data](https://www.expatistan.com/es/costo-de-vida/queretaro) is sparse; wine is estimated relative to local beer. Accommodation prices are holistic estimates and are less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation estimates use central Mexican urban and heritage destinations, including Guadalajara and Guanajuato, as a general regional basis, with an allowance for Querétaro's business and tourism demand.
